Name: Stardew Auto GC
Author: 1059Studio
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#f1c232]支持的语言 Supported languages[/color]
[/size]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]简体中文、英语，使用 i18n[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6b6b6][size=3]Simplified Chinese, English, use i18n.[/size][/color][/font][/list][list]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][color=#00ffff][size=2]这是全世界第一个使用 Visual Basic 语言编写并发布的星露谷模组[/size][/color]


[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#f1c232]功能 Function[/color]
[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]自动在每一天结束时运行 GC 内存回收并在 SMAPI 控制台和游戏内输出内存用量[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#b6b6b6]Automatically run GC RAM recycling at the end of each day and output RAM usage in the SMAPI console and in-game.
[/color] 
[/size][/font][*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]按 右 Alt 键可以在任何时候立即触发，可配置[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6b6b6]Press the right Alt key to trigger immediately at any time, configurable.[/color]

[/font]
[/size][/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=5]注意 Notice[/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]不在每天开始的时候自动运行是因为这样做很容易造成整天都一直卡顿[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#b6b6b6]It does not run automatically at the beginning of each day because it is easy to cause stuck all day long.
[/color] 
[/size][/font][*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]更适用于 32 位游戏，并不能解决因为程序设计问题导致的内存必炸，清不下去就是真的清不下去，但至少你可以预估你的32位游戏距离内存爆炸还差多远（注意因为游戏的程序问题，32位的游戏不到4GB就会炸）[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#b6b6b6]It is more suitable for 32-bit games and cannot solve the memory explosion caused by programming problems. If you can’t clear it, you can’t clear it. At least you can estimate how far your 32-bit game is from the memory explosion (note Because of the game program problem, 32-bit games will explode if less than 4GB).
[/color] 
[/size][/font][*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]但现在大家基本上都在用 64 位游戏了，所以这个模组的功能基本上也就是拿来随时清理或者看一下内存了[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6b6b6]But now everyone is basically using 64-bit games, so the function of this mod is basically to clean up or look at the memory at any time.
[/color][/font]
